resources.string: Sign in with Google to save your campaign stars, Daily Challenge runs, and Global Leaderboard rank.
Drag a block out from lower layers, then tap the glowing top zone to stack it higher!
Pull smoothly along the axis to keep the Precision Bar green and earn Combo multipliers!
Watch out for Wind, Earthquakes, Rain, and TNT! Use Freeze, Glue, Shield, Undo, or Mini Crane to survive.
